"1246-01000119-50U" and "USB-AC56 V1.4" appears :to be silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. This adapter is using two ''[[Skyworks]] (SiGe)'' SE5003L1 :High Power 802.11ac (5GHz) WLAN Power Amplifiers. :The other RFICs may be from [http://www.epic.com.tw/ ''Epicom'']..
The USB ID for this device is found in the driver set for [[Edimax EW-7822UAC]]. :''[[Realtek]]'' Linux driver set for the '''8812au''' states the manufactuer is ''[[Edimax]]''. <small> *'''Warning:''' The [[ASUS USB-AC56]] adapters sold in the EU do not support channels higher than :140 under Windows 10. There are no relevant settings to configure, so the only solution is :to return the adapter. Adapters sold directly by Amazon (US) do not have this limitation. </small> ===Reviews=== *[http://www.smallnetbuilder.com/wireless/wireless-reviews/32271-ac1200-usb-wireless-adapter-roundup Featured in '''SmallNetBuilder''''s AC1200 USB Wi-Fi Adapter Roundup] *[http://www.thetechrevolutionist.com/2013/06/best-wireless-ac-usb-dongle-asus-usb.html ''ASUS USB-AC56 images and stuff'' on '''The Tech Revolutionist'''] :dongle form factor, RP-SMA connector w/ external 5dBi antenna
